            gsuM pa rtogs pa'i rtogs tshul gyis dbye ba la gsuM <lb n="46a4"/> las | rtog pas btags pa dgag pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="4235"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="3827">kha 1</rs></rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4235">khu</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">'brom</rs></note><note type="editorial">"Khu" is understood to refer to Khu ston brTson 'grus g.yung drung (ID:4235), but could also be Khu mDo sde 'bar (ID:3873)'.</note> chos bzod dang chos shes ma dag pa dang dag pa rtogs par gzhag ste ma dag pa chos mchog man chad las khad nye ba dang ring bas zhes so || 

            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="3834"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="3837">kha 1</rs></rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3837">gnyan</rs></note><note type="editorial">The identification of "gnyan" as g.Yor gnyan (ID:3837) is tentative.</note> mthong lam dang mthong spang skye 'gag byed bzhin pa dang des <lb n="46a5"/> dben pas so zhes smra'o ||  
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3820">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3820">kar</rs></note><note type="editorial">The identification of "kar" as 'Dul 'dzin dkar mo (ID:3820) is tentative.</note> rgyud sgom spang dang mthong spang gis ma dag pa dang dag pas so zhes grag go ||</seg></TEI>
